prompt: Create a vertical 9:16 hand-cut linocut print in two colours, black ink and one sickly mustard yellow, on rough cream paper with visible gouge marks, uneven ink coverage and slight misregistration. A tiny corner shop seen from its doorway at night: shelves of tins rendered in hatched lines, a loaf of plain white bread centred on the counter under a single hanging bulb, the only yellow in the picture. A price card propped against the loaf reads "50p" in chunky hand-carved letters. The shop's back wall is solid black ink, and in that black the carver has left the faint unprinted outline of a doorway that should not be there. Folk-horror woodcut feeling, stark and simple. Thanks.
